stem.text: The diagram shows a Boltzmann distribution of the energies of gaseous molecules and the activation energies, $E_\text{a}$, of a reaction with and without a catalyst.

stem.alt: Boltzmann distribution curve: proportion of molecules with energy E against molecular energy E. Activation energies Ea1 and Ea2 are marked on the energy axis, and the area under the curve beyond each is hatched.

stem.text: Which statement about this distribution curve is correct?

A.text: If the temperature of the gas is increased, the maximum of the curve becomes higher.

B.text: If the temperature of the gas is increased, the maximum of the curve moves to the left.

C.text: The fraction of molecules that react in the presence of a catalyst is shown by

C.alt: Small rectangle filled with diagonal hatching sloping up to the right

D.text: The fraction of molecules that react in the absence of a catalyst is shown by

D.alt: Small rectangle filled with diagonal hatching sloping down to the right
